empty.title: No counts yet
empty.text: Start one to line the stock up with what is really at home

startInventory.title: New count
startInventory.description: The current stock is frozen as the starting point and you correct it as you go

field.shiftHint: A morning count comes before that day's movements; an afternoon one, after

startInventory.explanation: On validation the stock becomes exactly what you counted. Whatever you leave uncounted is left untouched.

getInventory.validatedHint: This count is already validated. If you closed it by mistake, reopen it: everything counted is still there and the stock is written again when you validate.
getInventory.discardBody: You are about to discard this count without applying it
getInventory.discardWarning: Everything counted is lost. The stock stays as it is.

not.found: That line is no longer in the count

already.open: You already have a count in progress

nothing.counted: Write down at least one thing before validating

to.count: There is nothing stored to count

invalid.date: The date of the count is not valid
invalid.shift: The shift of the count is not valid

still.open: That count is already in progress
